dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Taking a rest to regain your strength? Good plan. After all, the road is long, and who knows what enemies lie ahead... It's best to plan our next step carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: That said, don't inflate your enemies' strength too much, or deem yourself too weak to face them.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: It is never wise to underestimate your enemies, but the same is true of your own abilities. Trust in what you can do, or you risk being foolish.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: As long as we have enough strength on our side, I doubt we'll run into anything that even warrants the word "challenge."

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: But I suppose, for those with energy to burn, rushing into battle unprepared is its own kind of thrill...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Personally, I'm all about preparation — silently and swiftly crushing all who stand in my way, and in the end... walking away with the exact outcome I want.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I had a little talk with the wolf cub over there. He told me some interesting stories about this place.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: It's fascinating... This is the first time I've been able to talk to an animal, and have them talk back. For a moment, I thought I'd gained some of the Lady Moonchanter's powers.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: But thankfully, that wasn't the case. It would be far too much of a hassle to expand my intelligence network to include animals...
